ios.desc:
Afham – Arabic Dialect Translator

Afham—meaning “I understand” in Arabic—bridges communication across the diverse Arabic dialects spoken throughout the Arab world. Designed for students, families, and learners of all levels, Afham makes translation simple, accurate, and accessible.

KEY FEATURES
DIALECT TRANSLATION

• Supports 9 major dialects and languages: English, Modern Standard Arabic, Egyptian, Levantine (Syrian/Lebanese/Jordanian/Palestinian), Gulf, Sudanese, Moroccan, Iraqi, and Yemeni.
• Accurate, context-aware translations between English and all supported dialects.

VOICE INPUT & OUTPUT

• Real-time speech-to-text for all dialects.
• Text-to-speech with clear, natural pronunciation and adjustable speed.
• Automatic language detection and visual feedback while recording.

COMPREHENSIVE PHRASEBOOK

• 60+ essential phrases across categories: Greetings, Family, Food & Dining, Directions, Shopping, Emergency, Numbers, and Time & Date.
• Every phrase available in all supported dialects and in English.
• Works offline for instant access.

FLEXIBLE SUBSCRIPTION PLANS

• Free Plan: 10 translations per month, full phrasebook, voice input/output, all dialects.
• Basic Monthly Plan: 150 translations per month.
• Pro Yearly Plan: 300 translations per month — best value.

MULTI-LANGUAGE INTERFACE

• Seamless switching between languages and dialects.
• Full right-to-left UI support for Arabic.

PRIVACY & SECURITY

• Translation history stored locally on your device.
• No data collection or tracking.
• Microphone access only when explicitly granted.

Afham is a powerful tool for learning Arabic, traveling, and staying connected with friends and family—offering clear communication across Arabic dialects and English.
